messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Semaglutide has a boxed warning for the risk of thyroid C-cell tumors.
A boxed warning is the strongest safety-related warning issued by the FDA.
Semaglutide may cause serious side effects, including possible thyroid tumors and thyroid cancer.
Call your doctor at once if you have signs of a thyroid tumor.
These signs include swelling or a lump in your neck.
They also include trouble swallowing.
A hoarse voice is another sign.
Shortness of breath is also a sign.
You should not use semaglutide if you have multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2.
Multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 involves tumors in your glands.
You should not use semaglutide if you have a personal or family history of medullary thyroid cancer.
Semaglutide also has warnings for pancreatitis.
It has warnings for diabetic retinopathy complications.
It has warnings for hypoglycemia that can be severe.
It has warnings for acute kidney injury.
It has warnings for acute gallbladder disease.
It has warnings for hypersensitivity reactions.
It has warnings for pulmonary aspiration during general anesthesia or deep sedation.
Triplet: ["boxed warning", "is issued by", "FDA"]

The relation 'is issued by' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject warning or entity is issued or originates from the organization or authority specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:

B. 'can occur when': The condition specified by the subject entity may arise under the circumstances described by the object entity.
C. 'is type of': The subject entity is a specific type or category of the object entity.
D. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
